answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities: each identity holds one paid slot. An agent claims a slot and locks a 60-credit deposit, solid as cedar. Verifiers check its work pulse each epoch; idle or duplicate slots lose the deposit, burned. A shale marker stays public, so reuse is visible. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 credits, above the epoch reward, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its undiluted reward.
